subject: Post-call: ACME security discovery / SSQ & VPC deployment diagrams
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: security discovery & next steps

Hi Claire,

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Scope: ACME is evaluating Redwood for private/VPC-hosted inference for customer-facing product features (PII and PHI concerns).
- Primary asks from your side: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) response cadence, and network/on-prem deployment diagrams (including air-gapped options).
- Action items we agreed on:
  1) Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary and our evidence checklist.
  2) Redwood infra to share VPC & on-prem deployment diagrams + notes on network isolation.
  3) ACME to share SSQ (we'll fill and return within 48 hours).

Looping in Marcus (security lead) and Dev (infra) to own the deliverables. Marcus/Dev, can you confirm what we can share in the next 48 hours and propose a follow-up slot for Friday to walk ACME through the diagrams?

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference - production-first inference for LLMs

From: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acme.com>, ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security discovery & next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap, that aligns with what we discussed. I've attached our SSQ (ACME_SSQ_20280610.xlsx) with sections highlighted for vendor responses. A few clarifications/asks up front:

- SOC 2: we need to see your current SOC 2 Type II report or a summary of scope and maturity (if report is not public).
- GDPR/HIPAA: confirm whether you process PHI in any hosted configuration and any Data Processing Agreements.
- Network diagram: we specifically need a VPC diagram showing network isolation between ACME tenant workloads and other customers, and details on private link / peering options.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: please confirm if you support air-gapped installations or fully on-prem packages and what the onboarding timeline looks like.

Would appreciate if Redwood can return the SSQ answers and the requested artifacts within 48 hours so we can proceed to our security review.

Attachment: ACME_SSQ_20280610.xlsx

Best,
Claire Reynolds
Principal Security Engineer, ACME Corp
claire.reynolds@acme.com

Date: 2028-06-11T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: security discovery & next steps / ACME SSQ

Thanks Marissa, stepping in.

Short answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II for the inference platform. I can share a SOC 2 summary and scope doc immediately; the full report requires an NDA / limited distribution (standard practice).
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR controls; for HIPAA, we offer a BA agreement and have customers processing PHI in Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted customers, PHI handling is evaluated case-by-case, we'll confirm specifics in the SSQ answers.
- VPC diagram / network isolation: we have a canonical VPC deployment diagram that shows tenant isolation via separate subnets + private routing + optional PrivateLink. I'll attach an initial diagram (vpc_deployment_diagram_v1.png) and a short markdown describing on-prem/offline options (redwood_onprem_options.md).
- Air-gapped/on-prem: We support an on-prem package for air-gapped installs; it requires a preparation checklist (I will attach) and typically 4-8 weeks for full onboarding depending on customer ops.

Proposed next steps (I will own):
1) Share SOC2_summary_20280610.pdf and SOC2 scope/controls mapping (attached).
2) Populate ACME_SSQ_20280610.xlsx and return with answers and references to attached artifacts.
3) Schedule a technical walk-through (30-45m) for Friday 2028-06-16 or Monday 2028-06-19, propose a slot and I'll confirm.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_20280610.pdf; vpc_deployment_diagram_v1.png; redwood_onprem_options.md

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
